title: Exotic Silky Portuguese Peaches Tart
description: A cultured and nostalgic Portuguese dish featuring peaches, miso-marinate, and a lacto-vegetarian friendly twist, this tart is perfect for warm summer evenings.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste and honey until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and cold unsalted butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add the eggs, one at a time, whisking until fully incorporated after each addition.
Gradually add the heavy cream, whisking until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom, trimming the edges to fit.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil and vanilla extract, then brush the mixture evenly over the bottom of the tart crust.
Arrange the peaches, sliced into wedges, in a circular pattern on top of the tart, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the miso-honey mixture evenly over the peaches.
Bake the tart for 40-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the peaches are tender.
